title: Audit Project Structure and Dependencies
description: Review the current project structure, scripts, dependencies, and environment variables to ensure the README will be accurate and comprehensive.
details: Examine the repository's folder structure, key files (such as app/layout.tsx, components/ui/, etc.), and the package.json for scripts and dependencies. Identify all required environment variables and check for the existence and completeness of .env.example. Gather all information needed for accurate documentation, including Node.js version requirements and any implicit setup steps.
test_strategy: Manually verify that all gathered information matches the actual project setup and that no required steps or variables are omitted.

title: Draft Comprehensive README.md
description: Create a well-structured README.md file that covers all required sections for developer onboarding and project understanding.
details: Write the README.md using Markdown, including the following sections: Title, badges (build status, license, etc.), project description, screenshot (if available), Features, Technology Stack, Getting Started (prerequisites, installation, running locally), Project Structure overview, Available Scripts (from package.json), Environment Variables (with reference to .env.example), Deployment instructions (including a 'Deploy to Vercel' button), and links to relevant documentation. Use clear language, code blocks for commands, and ensure logical flow.
test_strategy: Review the README for completeness, clarity, and formatting. Ensure all sections are present and instructions are easy to follow.

title: Verify and Update .env.example
description: Ensure the .env.example file exists and accurately lists all required environment variables referenced in the README and project code.
details: Cross-reference the environment variables used in the codebase and those documented in the README. Update or create the .env.example file to reflect all required variables, including example values and comments for clarity.
test_strategy: Attempt to copy .env.example to .env and run the project using the README instructions to confirm all variables are present and correct.

title: Manual Validation of README Instructions
description: Test all steps in the new README by following them from a clean clone to ensure accuracy and completeness.
details: Simulate a new developer onboarding by cloning the repository, following the README instructions for setup, installation, running, and deployment. Note any missing steps, unclear instructions, or errors, and update the README as needed to resolve issues.
test_strategy: Perform a full manual walkthrough of the README instructions on a fresh environment. Confirm that the project runs as expected and all documented scripts and commands work.
